text:
anya: heads up — CI on main is red, prompt-render/golden_tests failing on tests/test_prompt_render.py::test_prompt_baseline
ci-bot: build 4821 failed — snapshot mismatch in prompt-render (artifact: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/4821/artifacts/gold-diff/)
sam: :eyes: do we have a quick rerun? i can kick off a PR re-run if needed
miguel: can someone paste the diff? if it's just whitespace maybe we accept
anya: pasted diff below
```diff
--- expected
+++ actual
@@
-"Hello, how can I help you today?"
+"Hi! How can I help you today?"
```
maya: Noting this looks like punctuation/spacing change from the tokenizer update in runtime-optim. Prob caused by the token normalizer tweak in last week
sam: ok can you link the PR that changed tokenizer? i can bisect if needed
anya: PR #2894 touched tokenization normalizer. repro locally with: `pytest -q tests/test_prompt_render.py::test_prompt_baseline`
anya: repro steps:
```
python -m pytest tests/test_prompt_render.py::test_prompt_baseline -q
# then compare tests/gold/prompt_baseline.txt with out/last_run/prompt_baseline.txt
```
miguel: quick triage: if it's safe, we can update golden to new punctuation, but need product sign-off (might affect UI strings)
maya: tagging @product-bot for change advisory :warning:
product-bot: @product-team FYI — potential user-facing wording change detected in prompt baseline. Please advise.
sam: meanwhile i'll rerun CI with the runtime-optim revert patch to confirm
anya: thanks. adding logs + diff snapshot to the artifact link above
miguel: if rerun passes with revert, we do a bisect to the exact commit and open a patch to preserve desired behavior (or update golds intentionally)
anya: for the record, failure count is 3 snapshot diffs across variants (short, long, safety)
maya: also flagging that optimize-batching branch had a minor trim-whitespace change earlier this week — worth checking that PR too
sam: timeline: rerun in ~5m, will update here
sam: (later) rerun shows green with revert; confirmed tokenizer change is causal
anya: created quick PR #2902 to adjust token normalizer to preserve space-before-punct rule; added unit test and gold update plan
miguel: cool — please add CHANGELOG entry and ping docs + support for a customer-facing note if needed
anya: will do. closing thread when PR merged :white_check_mark:
